mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an aggressive monetary policy response to economic contraction, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate below 5.5% indicates improving labor market conditions that boost consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls below 5.5%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) signals a broad-based economic recovery that increases corporate revenue expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS show positive growth, or interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods when the CPI index exceeds 230 (indicating high inflation), a decline in the federal funds rate is interpreted as a preemptive measure to avoid stagflation, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate future rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS declines, or interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment above 130,000 thousand persons signals robust job growth that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 130,000, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in housing starts below 1,000 thousand units indicates a weakening housing market that reduces construction sector activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST falls below 1000, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and residential construction (HOUST) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that reduces corporate output and investment, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 400,000 million dollars), a low GDP level (GDPC1 < 16,500 billion dollars) signals a weakening economy that leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate profits.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances (RSAFS > 400000 and GDPC1 < 16500), or interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03.
